ui.title: Floppy Station
ui.coming_soon: This tab comes in the next update.
ui.drive.off: Detection is off: the drive isn't checked.

ui.disk.off: Turn detection on to read the disk.

ui.game.no_process: It won't be closed when the disk is removed: no process to close is set.
ui.prefs.click_hint: An empty drive clicks on every check. Longer intervals click less but notice disks later.
ui.prefs.removal.close: Ask the game to close, force it after
ui.prefs.reset_confirm: Restore all preferences to their defaults? The drive stays the same.
box.blank: This disk has no game yet.
box.untrusted: This disk wants to run a program you haven't approved.
box.missing: The program on this disk isn't installed on this PC.

box.unusable: This disk can't be read. It may be damaged.
box.newer: This disk was set up by a newer version of Floppy Station.
drive_disconnected: Drive {drive} not found. Plug the drive in, or pick another letter in Preferences.
detection_off: Disk detection is off: Floppy Station ignores the drive until you turn it on again.
disk_not_configured: This disk has no game yet.

disk_unsupported_version: This disk was set up by a newer version of Floppy Station.

disk_unformatted: This disk isn't formatted. Format it in File Explorer first.
disk_unreadable: This disk can't be read. It may be damaged.

disk_write_protected: The disk is write protected. Slide the tab and try again.

disk_write_failed: The file could not be verified after writing. Try again or use another disk.
